sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Technology stands alone as the sole all-green sector with dominant 0.967 momentum, while broader market breadth remains exceptionally narrow with only 1 of 11 groups positive across all timeframes.

Leadership is tightly concentrated at the top. Technology (momentum 0.967, rank 2) and Energy (momentum 0.800, rank 1) continue to outpace the broader market, with Industrials making positive headway into the top four. 

Meanwhile, rotation remains muted across most sectors. Minor ground was gained by Communication Services and Industrials, but defensive and interest-sensitive groups are fading, marked by slipping ranks in Healthcare and Real Estate, alongside persistent basement-level momentum in Utilities and Consumer Cyclical.

## Strength
- **Sole All-Green Performer:** Technology is the only group out of 11 positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD timeframes, posting a 0.967 momentum score.
- **Sustained Leadership:** Technology also represents the only sector exhibiting sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Top Rank Stability:** Energy maintains the top YTD spot (rank 1) with strong 0.800 momentum, holding steady alongside Technology (rank 2).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Advancing Groups:** Industrials improved +1 spot to rank 4 with a 0.633 momentum score, while Communication Services gained +1 spot to rank 8 (0.567 momentum).
- **Declining Groups:** Healthcare slipped -1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.567), and Real Estate fell -1 spot to rank 9 with a weak 0.133 momentum score.
- **Momentum Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical anchors the bottom at rank 11 (0.300 momentum), alongside Utilities at rank 10 (0.217 momentum) and Real Estate at rank 9 (0.133 momentum).

## Divergences
- **Narrow Breadth:** Extreme divergence between the market leaders and the rest of the field, with only 1 of 11 sectors managing all-green performance.
- **Communication Services Rank vs. Momentum:** Communication Services registers top-half momentum (0.567), contrasting with its low YTD position at rank 8.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Core leadership remains anchored in energy, tech hardware, and industrials, while defensive healthcare and pharma groups are experiencing sharp multi-day liquidations.

Broad market strength is narrow, with only 13 of 144 groups qualifying as all-green across all major timeframes. Dominance continues in Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.992 momentum) and the semiconductor complex, while capital rotated aggressively into select laggards such as Medical Distribution (+20 spots) and Utilities - Regulated Water (+18 spots). 

Conversely, widespread weakness hit pharmaceuticals and defensive yield spaces. Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic dropped 19 spots, Pharmaceutical Retailers slipped 17 spots, and REIT - Healthcare Facilities lost 12 spots. Meanwhile, cyclical pockets like Steel and Consumer Electronics are showing subtle fatigue despite high absolute momentum.

## Strength
- **Narrow leadership core:** Only 13 of 144 industry groups are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods.
- **Top sustained performers:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.992, rank_ytd 2) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (momentum 0.978, rank_ytd 3) hold top-tier momentum alongside Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.952) and Semiconductors (0.951).
- **Persistent strength:** Marine Shipping (0.936), Communication Equipment (0.93), Scientific & Technical Instruments (0.91), and Copper (0.89) all maintained top-36 rankings across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest short-term climbers:** Medical Distribution surged 20 spots to rank 60 (0.72 momentum), followed by Aerospace & Defense (+18 to rank 72, 0.61 momentum) and Utilities - Regulated Water (+18 to rank 53, 0.68 momentum).
- **Notable software improvement:** Software - Infrastructure advanced 12 spots to rank 40 with strong 0.83 momentum, while Software - Application climbed 9 spots to rank 111 (0.61 momentum).
- **Steepest decliners:** Severe drops concentrated in pharma, led by Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic (-19 to rank 100, 0.40 momentum) and Pharmaceutical Retailers (-17 to rank 122, 0.40 momentum).
- **Bottom-tier momentum:** Advertising Agencies (0.037 momentum, rank_ytd 144), REIT - Mortgage (0.049, rank_ytd 131), and Gambling (0.055, rank_ytd 143) remain anchored at the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading momentum leaders:** Steel (0.80 momentum, -3 spots over 5 sessions), Consumer Electronics (0.75 momentum, -4 spots), and Department Stores (0.73 momentum, -2 spots) are seeing their short-term ranks slip despite elevated momentum readings.
- **Emerging low-momentum rebounds:** Luxury Goods jumped 12 spots over 5 days despite weak 0.42 momentum; similarly, Uranium rose 7 spots with a 0.27 momentum score, and Utilities - Regulated Electric gained 7 spots carrying a 0.36 momentum score.
